newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DECISION ON S.KOREAN FOKKER RESCUE SEEN THURS - TV.
newsitem.headline: DECISION ON S.KOREAN FOKKER RESCUE SEEN THURS - TV.

text.p: The South Korean government will decide on Thursday whether to give the go-ahead for a takeover of bankrupt Dutch planemaker Fokker by Samsung Aerospace , Dutch television said on Tuesday.
A spokesman for the Dutch economic affairs ministry said he could not confirm the report.

"It is based solely on rumours, expectations, etcetera," spokesman Luuc van Zijp said. "A number of weeks ago things reached a particular point at which Samsung said it was going to conduct internal consultations... and that's it."
There had been no developments since then, he said.

Dutch television news said Fokker administrators, the Dutch government and Samsung had reached agreement on the wording of a memorandum of understanding regarding a takeover, but that the South Korean government would have the final say.

"Fokker administrators, Samsung and the Dutch government are agreed in principle on the text of a memorandum of understanding, but the Korean government...will be the one to bring things to a head," Dutch television news said.
But Van Zijp said no memorandum of understanding existed and that he could not confirm a decision would follow on Thursday.
"I saw it (the television report) too, but nothing that was certain," he said.
Fokker's administrators were not reachable for comment on Tuesday night.
